items.title: Fill PDFs with API, AI creates optimal layouts
items.raw_excerpt: Hey HN, I’m Carlos, dev & designer behind Hundred Docs. Here’s the deal: I’ve spent way too many days fighting PDFs in production. Two things drove me crazy: 1. Most doc tools give total freedom → anyone can make a layout disaster + UX is terrible. 2. PDF libraries are a nightmare to integrate So I hacked something that actually works: - You describe the doc in plain English - AI turns it into an editable template - Non-tech folks can tweak it visually - Devs just POST JSON to an API → get a professional PDF back Would love to hear what you think about the product idea and your experience with PDF generation in software products.

items.title: 对话黑芝麻CMO杨宇欣：机器人平台发布前已创收，是自然过渡而非跨界
items.raw_excerpt: “比较幸运的是，我们坚持了最开始相信的事。” 在被问及黑芝麻智能如何在机器人赛道守住先发优势时，黑芝麻智能 CMO 杨宇欣语气笃定。 日前，黑芝麻智能于其机器人平台产品发布会上正式官宣布局机器人业务，推出业界首个机器人商业化专属部署平台——SesameX™多维具身智能计算平台，包含Kalos（视觉驱动）、Aura（感控协同）、Liora（认知进化）三大核心模块，已应用于物流车、四足机器人等场景。 对于此次机器人平台的布局，杨宇欣明确表示，这并非跨界之举，而是业务的自然延伸。据雷峰网了解，黑芝麻智能的机器人业务在2024年底启动，截至目前已有多个项目成功落地。该业务在公司整体营收中占比仍较低，尚处于战略布局阶段，但却是其从智能汽车计算芯片向全域智能计算平台拓展的关键里程碑。 黑芝麻智能坚定扮演 “赋能者” 角色，它并未选择亲自下场造机器人，短期内也无专为机器人研发芯片的计划，而是立足芯片主业，最大限度复用智驾领域的技术与生产经验，在工具链、IO 等维度适配现阶段机器人客户的场景需求。 从商业落地来看，黑芝麻智能为机器人业务线锚定了 “卡位 + 布局” 的核心定位。“卡位” 是指在未来机器人产业链中明确自身技术边界，“布局” 则是提前锁定潜在优质客户、理顺上下游产业关系。 从智驾芯片龙头向机器人算力平台拓展，黑芝麻智能试图卡位机器人赛道，成为 AI 时代的端侧 AI 计算平台供应商。 以下为黑芝麻CMO杨宇欣、机器人业务线负责人徐劲与雷峰网等媒体的对话内容，雷峰网作了不改变原意的编辑： Q：机器人平台发布之后，商业化进程大概是怎样的？大概多久能够在推进过程中看到一些收益体现？ 杨宇欣：实际上，黑芝麻的机器人业务早在 2024 年底就启动布局，之所以现在才发布相关平台，是因为目前机器人市场仍处在非常早期的阶段，很难说我们已经摸清了市场的边界。 但从业务落地的角度来看，黑芝麻机器人

excerpt_i18n.en: Fortunately, we have persisted in what we initially believed in. When asked how Black Sesame Technologies maintains its first-mover advantage in the robotics field, CMO Yang Yuxin spoke with conviction. Recently, Black Sesame Technologies officially announced its entry into the robotics business at its robotics platform product launch, introducing the industry's first dedicated commercial deployment platform for robotics—the SesameX™ multi-dimensional embodied intelligence computing platform. It includes three core modules: Kalos (vision-driven), Aura (sensory-control synergy), and Liora (cognitive evolution), which have already been applied in scenarios such as logistics vehicles and quadruped robots. Regarding this robotics platform initiative, Yang Yuxin clearly stated that it is not a cross-industry move but a natural extension of the business. According to Leiphone, Black Sesame Technologies' robotics business began at the end of 2024, and several projects have already been successfully implemented to date. This business still accounts for a relatively low proportion of the company's overall revenue and remains in the strategic planning stage, but it marks a key milestone in its expansion from intelligent automotive computing chips to a comprehensive intelligent computing platform. Black Sesame Technologies firmly plays the role of an "enabler." It has not chosen to manufacture robots itself and has no plans to develop chips specifically for robotics in the short term. Instead, it focuses on its core chip business, maximizing the reuse of technology and production experience from the intelligent driving field, and adapting to the current scenario needs of robotics customers in dimensions such as toolchains and I/O. From a commercial implementation perspective, Black Sesame Technologies has anchored the core positioning of "securing a foothold + strategic layout" for its robotics business line. "Securing a foothold" refers to positioning in the future robotics
excerpt_i18n.es: Afortunadamente, hemos mantenido nuestra creencia inicial. Al ser preguntado sobre cómo Black Sesame Intelligent mantiene su ventaja pionera en el campo de la robótica, Yang Yuxin, CMO de la empresa, respondió con firmeza. Recientemente, Black Sesame Intelligent anunció oficialmente su expansión en el negocio de robótica durante el lanzamiento de su plataforma de productos, presentando la primera plataforma de implementación comercial exclusiva para robótica del sector: la Plataforma de Computación de Inteligencia Corporal Multidimensional SesameX™. Esta incluye tres módulos principales: Kalos (impulsado por visión), Aura (coordinación sensorial y de control) y Liora (evolución cognitiva), ya aplicados en escenarios como vehículos logísticos y robots cuadrúpedos. Respecto a esta expansión en la plataforma de robótica, Yang Yuxin expresó claramente.

items.title: Why many AI-generated websites don't show up on Google
items.raw_excerpt: We’ve been experimenting quite a bit with AI website builders and kept seeing the same pattern: Sites often look finished to users — modern UI, fast loads, everything appears “done” — but when search engines crawl them, much of the main content isn’t actually present yet. In many cases the issue isn’t SEO basics, keywords, or content quality. It’s simply when the HTML is generated and what Google receives on first visit. We wrote up a calm, non-marketing explanation of what’s going on, how to spot it yourself (even if you’re not very technical), and why this keeps happening with many modern AI builders. items.title: Why do so many "agentic AI" systems collapse without persistent state?
items.raw_excerpt: I’ve been thinking a lot about what’s currently called “agentic AI”. Many systems try to achieve agent-like behavior through planning, tool use, orchestration layers, or increasingly careful prompting. In practice, what I keep running into is that these systems don’t fail because models can’t reason or plan, but because they lack stable state. Without persistent state, coherence has to be re-established every turn. The result is longer prompts, retrieval pipelines, guardrails, and corrective instructions — all of which help access information, but don’t really solve continuity over time. I’ve been experimenting with a different approach: making state explicit and persistent outside the model, but directly attached to the assistant’s working environment.
